headline: Co-op and creator tools improve as Going Commando integrates 842 matched functions
summary: OpenRAC's development line fixes Drone Device spawns and Novalis sparks, adds optional lower-latency controls and baked environment reflections, and guides creators through editing and packing levels. Custom destinations landed for PAL, with NTSC-U support and manual gameplay validation still incomplete; stable v0.10.0 was proposed but did not land today. OpenRAC mods share co-op progression and smooth remote movement, while SDK 1.10.1 enables Android native-mod releases including Multiplayer v0.7.3. Going Commando integrates an 842-function contribution in rac2-decomp#368, reaching 65.83% matched code for USA v1.01, while Up Your Arsenal gains NTSC-U frontend routines and Deadlocked integrates US and PAL matching batches. The original game's decompilation has a readability proposal, with no commits landed today.
